'''Ronam''' will be the clan chief of the [[Taardad]] Aiel seventeen years after the [[Last Battle]] seen by [[Aviendha]] in the [[Glass columns]] of [[Rhuidean]].

Ronam is the son of [[Rhuarc]]. In Aviendha's vision of her daughter [[Padra]] Padra states he is ten years older than she.  In this vision Ronam recalls seeing [[Rand al'Thor]] when the man had visited [[Cold Rocks Hold]]. He attends the meeting where the Aiel decide to go to war with the [[Seanchan]]. After the decision has been made, he and [[Padra]] discuss it and neither are sure it was the right thing to do.
